timeline.summary: Sanofi India received a GST refund order of ₹52.08 lakh for the August 2014 to June 2017 period.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹472.3 Cr (-11.9% YoY), net profit ₹102.6 Cr (-14.1% YoY).

Sanofi India Limited’s 70th AGM on April 29, 2026, passed all 11 resolutions, including financial statements and dividends (interim ₹75/share, final ₹48/share), with unanimous shareholder approval via e-voting.
On May 27, 2026, Sanofi India disclosed that tax authorities in Kerala dropped GST scrutiny proceedings amounting to ₹0.60 Cr for FY 2020-21.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹491.7 Cr (+3.4% YoY), net profit ₹116.7 Cr (+53.6% YoY).
